svg.title: IMG-03-03 Hazard zones, top view
svg.desc: Owner 2026-11-15: to scale. Travel path = swept path + 500 mm each side, clear to 2100 mm; pivot zone circle 2500 mm; coupling zones. Swept path from swept-path-evot: AGV CAD 574 wide, axle 380 from rear; 2 trolleys 1550 x 1200 (width = manual 5.2 maximum), measured hitch geometry 2026-10-09; R1000 right turn. AGV drawn from the CAD top view.
svg.text: Travel path: widest part (vehicle or trolley) + 500 mm each side, clear to 2100 mm. Keep free
Curves: the trolleys cut inside the curve; the travel path is wider on the inside
Coupling zone: between vehicle and trolley and between trolleys. Enter only when stopped
Pivot zone: circle Ø 2500 mm around the pivot point. Keep free while the vehicle is there
To scale. Trolleys 1550 × 1200 (largest allowed width); smallest tape radius 1000; swept path simulated. Dimensions in mm.
